mentions.name: Breadboard-able analog computing modules
mentions.description: This project is a set of breadboard-able analog computer modules, inspired by a 1970s hobbyist electronics magazine project. The modules have been breadboarded and prototyped and are currently in the PCB-layout stage, targeted for release early next year.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I have been bread-boarding and prototyping small analog computer modules. I'm in the PCB-layout stage for the modules and hope to have them ready early next year.
